artworks.title: Sophonisba
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a classical interior scene. The drawing features a standing figure in historical attire gesturing or speaking, while a seated figure in a draped garment is raising a cup. The setting includes classical architectural elements like columns and an arch. The composition uses intricate linework to establish texture and depth, focusing on detailed clothing and facial expressions. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance or early baroque printmaking techniques, with a clear influence of Northern European art.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his right arm raised, holding a long object resembling a spear or staff. He is turned slightly to his right, gazing in that direction with a serious expression. He has short, wavy hair and elaborate attire, including a flowing garment with sleeves, decorative chains, brooches, and medallions. He wears tight-fitting foot coverings. Next to him is an animal skin with detailed features. The background is minimally shaded.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing full-length and facing slightly to the right. The person on the left is holding long musical instruments, while the other individual stands beside them. Both have curly hair, with the person on the left having more defined curls. The individual on the left has distinct facial features with a slightly turned head, a straight nose, and a visible chin. The person on the right has a less angled face and a softer expression. Both are dressed in elaborate 16th-century attire featuring doublets, puffed shorts, ornamental boots, and heavily draped robes. The left person is gripping the musical instruments with both hands. In the backdrop, there is an intricate design with a lined pattern containing the date "1538" and the signature initials "AG" within a square frame.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: This print depicts a man and a woman standing side by side. The woman is in profile, facing left, while the man stands slightly behind her on the right, also in profile, facing towards the woman. The woman has a high forehead with a hairstyle that forms a large loop or bun at the back of her head. She wears an elaborate dress, with heavy embroidery and a ruffled collar, along with an ornate necklace. The man has a long, full beard and wears a soft cap on his head. He is dressed in a luxurious cloak with wide sleeves and embroidery. He is reaching over to the left with one hand, where he holds one of the woman's hands. The ground they stand on is a small hill shaded with crosshatching lines. The background is plain, with a small rectangular panel in the top right inscribed with the year "1538" and a monogram.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image displays two full-length figures, a man and a woman, standing closely together. The woman stands slightly in front of the man, both facing left. The woman has intricate facial features and her hair is styled elegantly, adorned with a detailed jeweled crown. She is dressed in an elaborate gown decorated with embroidery and jewels and holds a small purse. The man beside her has subtler facial features and wears a soft cap. He is dressed in an equally elaborate outfit, including a fur-trimmed cloak and tunic, holding a walking cane. The background contains the initials 'J E' in the upper left corner and the number '4' in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from head to toe. The male figure has one arm around the female figure, and the other arm pointing outward. He has a long, intricately styled beard, and wears a small cap on his head. His clothing is elaborate, with a puffed, striped doublet, short trousers, a cape draped over his shoulders, voluminous sleeves, hose, pointed shoes, and a sword at his side. The female figure stands beside him, looking in the opposite direction, with delicate facial features, hair up, an ornate hat, a long flowing gown with wide sleeves, and a cross brooch at her chest. The background is plain, with a small engraved monogram and the year 1538 in the upper-left corner.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of two individuals, a woman and a man, standing close together in an embrace. The woman stands facing forward with her body slightly turned to her left. Her facial features are prominent with a round face, eyes looking slightly upward, and full lips. Her hair is styled intricately with a headpiece or lace. She is dressed in a textured dress with puffed sleeves, bows, and a long skirt. The man stands with his back partially to the viewer, his arm around the woman. He has curly short hair and wears a doublet, trunk hose, a jacket, stockings, and pointed shoes. He carries a ceremonial sword at his belt. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed attire and woodcut or engraving technique.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing close together. The woman, on the left, has detailed hair styling with a headpiece, wearing a long dress with a cloak. The man, on the right, has a beard and is wearing a hat, cloak, breeches, and hose. The man's right hand appears to hold the woman's left hand, with a decorative sword by his side. The background has a corner with what appears to be paper with numbers and symbols, including the number "7" at the top left corner.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: Two figures in a three-quarter length portrait are shown standing in profile facing each other towards the left side of the frame. The person on the left appears to be female, with delicate facial features, neatly styled hair covered by an ornate headdress, wearing a voluminous, textured gown with detailed patterns, and clasping her hands in front of her. The male figure on the right stands slightly in front of her with his legs crossed, adorned in an extravagant cloak with elaborate folds and textures, frills around the neck, and holding a cane in his right hand. His hair is curly and capped with a beret. The background is a plain, unadorned surface, drawing focus to the intricate detailing in the clothing and the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: There are two people in full-length view. The man stands in front, while the woman stands beside him. The man has short hair and wears a beret with feathers, a doublet, breeches, a cloak, and carries a sword. The woman has styled hair, a headpiece, and wears an adorned gown with jewelry. They are against a light backdrop with details in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures, a man and a woman, standing side by side. The woman is positioned with her body slightly turned to the left, while the man stands upright with one leg crossed in front of the other. Both figures have distinct facial features, characterized by pronounced noses and high foreheads. The woman has stylized hair pulled back into a bun, possibly adorned with a headpiece or ribbon, and the man wears a head cover that fits close to his scalp. The woman is dressed in a long, flowing garment with voluminous sleeves adorned with intricate cuffs, while the man wears a tunic that includes ornate detailing along the edges, puffed shorts, and tights. His outfit is further accentuated with a wide belt holding a decorated sword sheath, and he supports the sword in his right hand. Their attire appears to be accented with ornate ruffles and decorative elements. The background surrounding the figures is plain. There is a monogram and the date 1523 visible in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Large Wedding Dancers
artworks.description: The image shows three men playing wind instruments. The man on the left is playing a bagpipes-like instrument, the middle man is playing a larger wind instrument, and the man on the right is playing a similar large instrument. They are dressed in elaborate garments with buttons and sashes, and the man on the right wears a cape with a circular emblem on the shoulder. Their features are roughly drawn with expressive facial lines and furrowed brows. The background is plain with the numbers "76" and "12" visible.

artworks.title: A Couple of Lovers Seated
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated closely together on a bench. The man on the left is in profile view, while the woman on the right faces forward. The man has distinct facial features with a large nose and mustache, and his hair is short and wavy. He is wearing a detailed garment with what appears to be thick, ornate fabric and a feathered hat or shoulder piece. The woman has a serene expression, with smooth facial features, and she wears her long hair swept back and flowing behind her. Her attire appears to be an elegant, patterned dress with ruffles and a high outfit with laces on the sleeves. She holds a small object in her right hand. The man holds a small goblet or cup in his left hand and another unidentifiable object in the other. Both wear decorative jewelry—bracelets and rings are visible. In the background, there is a pattern that suggests wooden or panel structures. The image has an intricate engraver's style, with detailed shading and texture throughout. The date "1529" and the initials "AG" are inscribed in the background.

artworks.title: The Night
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down on a bed, reclined against pillows with legs positioned at an angle and covered by a draped blanket. The person's head is turned to the side, with distinct facial features, including closed eyes and wavy hair tied back. The individual is nude, surrounded by sheets and pillows, with shadows and textile details. In the background, a window reveals a night scene with a crescent moon and stars. Beside the bed, there is a round container on a small table, and an inscription in Latin above the headboard. The words "DIE NACHT" are at the bottom of the image, while the setting includes ornamental carvings on the bedposts and headboard.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.3 x 12.6 cm (6 13/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has a round face, pronounced nose, and lips with a slight downturn at the corners. He has curly hair coming out from under a cap. The man wears a cap, a high-collared shirt, and a layered garment with a wide open collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is simple without distinct features, and below the portrait is a framed area with Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Albert van der Helle
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned in a seated or standing pose with his hands folded at the bottom of the image. The man's facial features include a prominent nose, a short and full curly beard, and a mustache. His eyes are gazing slightly to the side. He has a textured fabric cap on his head, beneath which his curly hair is visible. He wears a richly detailed garment that features a fur or similarly textured collar, with intricate decorations running down its front. The garment has a patterned texture, suggesting it is made from a luxurious fabric. Surrounding him is a textured background that seems to represent a stylized environment. The engraving includes text at the bottom, identifying him as "IMAGO ALBERTI VON DLR HELLENO" and markings of the year "1538."

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile view. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and lips. He has a serious expression and short, wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat with decorative elements. The man wears Renaissance-style clothing with intricate details, including a beaded necklace and a textured background with a coat of arms or shield-like element bearing a letter. Latin inscriptions appear above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate floral design. The design features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized leaves and flowers emanating from a central point. The foliage is rendered with detailed line work. The background is filled with cross-hatching. At the very bottom of the design, a small square contains what appears to be stylized initials or a monogram.

artworks.title: Naked Infant Holding a Double Scroll of  Leafy Ornament
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines, curved shapes resembling leaves and flower petals in an intricate design. A small cherubic figure is located on the right side of the image among the decorative patterns. The leaves have detailed textures, reminiscent of Baroque and Rococo designs seen in antique carvings and architectural ornamentation.

artworks.title: Alphabet
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 × 12.5 cm (2 15/16 × 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the alphabet surrounded by decorative elements. The letters A to Z are displayed in pairs on a textured backdrop in a structured grid. Elaborate scrollwork and foliage frame the text. Two cherubs are depicted on either side of the frame: one on the left holds a horn-like object, and the other cherub on the right holds a globe in one hand and a staff in the other. Both figures are surrounded by detailed leaves and scroll patterns.

artworks.title: Dagger Sheath with Nude Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a nude human figure standing upright. The person is positioned in a contrapposto stance, with weight primarily on one leg and the other relaxed. Their head is slightly turned to the left, revealing a profile view of their face featuring classical European sculptural attributes such as a defined nose and lips. The figure's hair is flowing with soft, wavy lines, adding a sense of motion. The subject holds a draped fabric in one hand, partially covering the body. The background above the figure shows a pattern resembling smoke or clouds. The lower portion of the image features an intricate floral design with detailed leaves and blossoms arranged vertically. In the top right corner, a square with stylized initials is present. The entire scene is framed within a narrow, decorative elongated panel.

artworks.title: Dagger Sheath with Gentleman Holding a Parrot
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a three-quarter view, turned slightly to the right. They have a beard and mustache, and their hair is covered with a cap. The person is dressed in layered clothing with a cloak, a short garment, and stockings. In one hand, they hold an object, and a falcon rests on their other arm. The background is plain with some grass at their feet. Above them is a design with the letters 'AG,' and below them are floral motifs.

artworks.title: Dagger Sheath with the Whore of Babylon
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a vertical design with a nude female figure, ornate floral patterns, and a cherubic figure. The top section shows a nude female figure holding a chalice in her left hand, surrounded by a swirling, textured pattern. Below her is a decorative band and a symmetrical ornamentation of scrolls and foliage resembling an elaborate column. At the bottom, there is a cherubic figure holding up a circular object with outlined wings. The design is detailed and full of texture, created with a fine-line technique, focusing on human form and decorative arts in a compact composition.
